PostToolUse.command: bash -c 'for f in $(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM 2>/dev/null); do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; case "$f" in *api.ts|*generated*) continue;; esac; lines=$(wc -l < "$f" | tr -d " "); if [ "$lines" -gt 100 ]; then echo "FILE_SIZE_VIOLATION: $f has $lines lines (cap=100)"; fi; done; exit 0'
